summary: Vireo Growth Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an Arrangement Agreement to acquire all outstanding common shares of C21 Investments Inc. via a statutory plan of arrangement under British Columbia law. Each C21 common share will be exchanged for 0.023052 Vireo subordinate voting shares (Exchange Ratio), implying an undisclosed per-share value and premium. C21 options become replacement options in Vireo; restricted/deferred share units vest and settle pre-closing; warrants and debentures are assumed. No board recommendation or advisor named. The share-based consideration and cross-border structure create a risk-arb spread tied to Vireo's stock volatility. Watch for regulatory approvals, dissenting shareholder rights, and anti-dilution adjustments.
